contributions.claim: Yemeni government army announces Dawn of Yemen operation, aimed initially at Bab al-Mandab and Mocha, with an offensive also reported in Sanaa.
contributions.attribution: Yemeni army and officials via NOS

contributions.claim: Government minister claims restored Bab al-Mandab control; Houthi-linked media deny army territorial gains, and NOS notes contradictory sources.
contributions.attribution: Al-Eryani/Reuters versus Houthi-linked media via NOS
contributions.uncertainty: Control claim contested; no source-only definitive control finding.

contributions.claim: Houthis' earlier seizure of Mocha, Dhubab and Perim forms the background to the new offensive.
